sentences: Assume that Esme is the head judge.
Esme is not the head judge.
contradictions.explanation: These two statements directly assert and deny that Esme is the head judge.

sentences: Hugo and Nell worked different shifts.
Nell and Leo worked different shifts.
Hugo and Leo worked different shifts.
contradictions.explanation: With only three shifts and each pair of Hugo, Nell, and Leo working different shifts from each other, all three must occupy all three distinct shifts, which is possible, but combined with other staff like Esme and Jun also needing shifts, this overconstrains the three-shift system if more than three people must be uniquely assigned; however, if strictly limited to these three, it is consistent, so the contradiction arises only if additional staff are also required to have distinct shifts among just three slots, which is implied by the full staff list including Esme and Jun.
